## What is Instagram?

Instagram is a social media platform primarily focused on sharing **photos and videos**.

- Post images and videos
- Follow other users
- Like and comment on content
- Share Stories and Reels


## History

- **Released:** October 6, 2010  
- **Developed by:** Kevin Systrom and Mike Krieger  
- **Acquired by:** Facebook (now Meta) in 2012  

## How to Access
- Mobile app for **iOS and Android**  
- Web version: [instagram.com](https://www.instagram.com)  
- Available on tablets as well
![Instagram Logo](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/ace/standard/976/cpsprodpb/E802/production/_89649395_instagram_logo_976.jpg)

## Key Features

1. Stories: temporary posts that disappear after 24 hours  
2. Reels: short-form video content  
3. Direct Messages: private messaging  
4. Explore: discover new content and accounts
